div.span: New version replaces on macOS; on Linux and Windows only when the definition differs, and a current one only updates the record. Declined, cancelled, needs approval or elevation, or unavailable: back to the state before. The job of an old build never settles during Removing old. A hold has these ways out: the service answers, a new version, Repair or Install (they run past 3 attempts, and a failed Repair returns to Held). Windows Dyno has no agent service.

text.tspan: New version replaces on macOS; on Linux and Windows only when the definition differs, and a current one only updates the record. Declined, cancelled, needs approval or elevation, or unavailable: back to the state before. The job of an old

build never settles during Removing old. A hold has these ways out: the service answers, a new version, Repair or Install (they run past 3 attempts, and a failed Repair returns to Held). Windows Dyno has no agent service.
